purpose: Necessary complete earliest-MoE-layer routed coverage quality screen; no wholemodel latency/publication claim. C64 first, expanded controls deferred.

version.name: first64-v1
version.other_functions: All other layers, Deep dense0/shared, attention/router/head remain source-GGUF. Old later-layer maps remain immutable but are not installed in this version.
version.preserve_old_modes: Old D6/NL7/COPY_NL8 remain distinct and unchanged.

immutable_reuse.old_early_C: Reuse four early-layer C maps/scales/bias/support, tree/P/centers byte-for-byte; verify canonical row-W8 weights against old exports. Do not refit old maps.
immutable_reuse.old_targets: Reuse the four early Y archives only under their immutable hashes and exact union bindings. Current-X semantic binding does not assert retroactive historical capture identity.
immutable_reuse.later_maps: Never mounted; do not overwrite any old artifact/source.

training.inputs: Exact existing complete ordered oldFIT120+PGTRAIN16 union, authoritative union input/target identities, no new states or refresh.
training.geometry: Frozen shared tree32/P128/normal and centers; no tree/repartition/whitening/projection selection.

new_C_recipe.lowering: Existing canonical row-W8 maps, actual deployed A8/frozen dot/scale prediction residual-mean F32 bias
new_C_recipe.cutoff: Existing relative1e-10 pseudoinverse and normalized trace penalties

training.old_exception: OLM L0E17 lambda.001 artifact preserved only for that already fitted expert.
training.support: Use frozen all-x support rules; routed hits are diagnostic only and never cause fallback. Nonfinite weights/fits or numeric failure are technical-invalid and stop; never silently create a favorable fallback.
training.sharing: Layer design/covariance/eigensystems reused across experts; stream one expert targets/fit at a time.

new_Y.retention: Preserve typed raw Y and row/weight/engine manifests/hashes. GU exists transiently inside Y but is not separately retained/exported or a free later query.

phase_scope.SOURCE_BUILD_GENERATED_ONLY: New stage4-prefixed helpers/harness only; generated arrays, build/numeric/IPC/lifecycle tests. No model/weight/target/capture/book/eval payload reads. Old sources unchanged.
phase_scope.BIND_EXISTING64: Separately released real binding/export of complete TRAIN identities, old4 artifacts and new canonical W8 weights from the pinned GGUF. No new Y production, fitting or validation bodies.
phase_scope.AUDIT_PREFLIGHT: Separately released finite correctness/rate audit using one unseen expert per model selected before values by SHA256 ASCII stage4-preflight-v1/<model>/<layer>/<expert>. Exactly256 fixed TRAIN rows per model (128oldFIT,64PGprefix,22Bdecode,21Cdecode,21Ddecode) chosen by provenance hash. Preserve row IDs and deliberately repeated teacher/audit work separately; no quality conclusions or hyperparameter choices from preflight.
phase_scope.FIT_C64: One full production Y pass and fixed C fits for the124 new experts only, all retained data and finite/archive/B1/direct numeric audits. No expanded D/NL/SO fitting, new states or validation.
phase_scope.ACQUIRE_FRESH16_TOKENIZE: Only after all C64 bytes are frozen and Root/critic reviewed: pinned16 exact generation bodies, strict integrity/preprocess/joint native512GT tokenization. No substitution or other source.
phase_scope.QUALITY_C64: Source/B64/C64 actual reference runs on all16, fresh ownKV, firstbook copy controls, earliest layer X/IDs/finalalpha equality, all slots counted and fixed statistics. No free generation or new fit.

audit_rules.canonical: Reuse frozen W8/A8/SiLU/scale arithmetic; exact signed-dot versus independent I64, whole-I private quantization and no accidental saturating intrinsic. FP64 DGEMM teacher acceleration only under the established integer-exact<2^53 proof.
audit_rules.archive: Finite F32 shapes/dtypes/support/model hashes, four predetermined TRAIN vectors, B1/batch/archive/IPC equality; all-row rather than spot output checks.
audit_rules.costs: Bill production, fit/calibration, preflight, B1/archive/direct-private/I64 and timing/reference work separately. Deliberate audit recomputation is not hidden as another production pass.
audit_rules.on_issue: Preserve partials; technical failure/incomplete/reference wiring does not increment failed-round count; no automatic retry/refit or source edits.

evaluation.ranking: SHA256 ASCII pg19-v1/<split>/<decimal_book_id>, ascending raw digest; ties ascending numeric ID
evaluation.old_exposed16_role: development only; no replay to select C64 recipe

preprocessing.download: Only after source/numeric/protocol approval: exact selected16validationobjects, requested pinned generation, verify advertised size and base64MD5 before decoding; preserve original bytes and SHA256. No bulk dataset/HellaSwag payload. If pinned object missing/changed, report acquisition/tooling blocker; do not silently substitute generation/book.
preprocessing.book_unit: All16 selected books, no content/loss-based exclusion or replacement.
preprocessing.window: Decode UTF-8 strictly; normalize CRLF then remaining CR to LF. Let midpoint=floor(number of Unicode codepoints/2). Find first LF at or after midpoint; start at character after LF, or midpoint if no LF. Use unchanged suffix from that start. Record midpoint/start and suffix SHA256. No paragraph/content search.
preprocessing.tokenization: Pinned model-specific native tokenizer on complete suffix, add_special=true, parse_special=false, no chat template. Use first512 IDs. First256 IDs (including native added special tokens) are context; next256 are groundtruth. Tokenize jointly, not separate context/continuation. If less512, retain book as insufficient and whole primary screen inconclusive; no substitute.
preprocessing.groundtruth_score: For target token index j=256..511 inclusive, use logits produced at j-1 in that arm's own context, feed actual groundtruth tokens to every arm. Exactly256 scored tokens/book/model/arm. Fixed batch/ubatch128, context1024; all arms same tokens/batching/threads.

evaluation.reference: B64 canonically replaces all64 experts only at the early layer; source elsewhere. B8 NLL cannot be reused.

contexts.rule: All contexts fresh ownKV and live routing; no teacher route/KV patch.

evaluation.firstlayer_invariance: At each of512 positions/book/model compare owned ffn_norm F32 bytes, ordered I32 IDs and final actual multiply-alpha F32 bytes across source/B64/C64, zero mismatches. Identical fixed histories, positions, four128 batches, backend/numerics required. No cross-rechunk or divergent-generation identity claim.
evaluation.exposure: All64 IDs eligible. Join worker returned/scattered rows by run/context/book/layer/expert/zone, exact selected-slot counts/alpha, approximate/fallback distinction. No routed-hit-based mask.
evaluation.controls: Firstbook actual all-vocab/trace source-nohook/copy, B64-copy and C64-copy; canonical copy must preserve the declared row-W8/A8 function.
evaluation.scores: All16 books, exactly256 finite target NLLs at targets256..511/logits255..510;512GT4x128, extra511 fed but not scored. Keep individual outliers.

statistical_primary.procedure: Shared16book draws, centeredmaxabsT, linear95quantile, same frozen prior implementation semantics
statistical_primary.valid_pass: Both simultaneous upper bounds strictly below margin.
statistical_primary.bounded_failure: Any valid lower bound strictly above margin, with complete numerical/exposure/reference integrity, permits Root+critic adjudication of this fixed first64-v1 quality/budget failure only. No automatic candidate/family failure.
statistical_primary.inconclusive: Crossing interval, zero/undefinedSD, missing/incomplete/nonfinite book or failed integrity stays inconclusive; no dropping/redrawing/substitution.

evaluation.reference_issue: Material source-to-B64 degradation or invalid reference requires separate scientific review; do not attribute it silently to C.
evaluation.later_controls: Replays on these exposed16 books are secondary/development only. No retrospective larger maxT family or claim of new independent confirmation.
evaluation.free_generation: Not part of this necessary GT phase. A later separately frozen generation diagnostic is required before broad autoregressive-quality claims.

D64.old_early_D: Reuse four early fixed D functions byte-identically under bindings.
D64.new_default: PE-RRR q512, W8 B/U, host_floatlatent, identity gauge; same newC eta0/lambda.01 and existing symmetricEVD/cutoff/normalized moments, deployed bias. No G/PE selection.
D64.teacher_queries: No new Y; shared C64 Y reused.
D64.version: New D64, not old D8 or all-global G.

NL64.old_early_NL: Reuse four early Stage3 NL7 functions/targets under exact identity; old8 files unchanged.
NL64.new_recipe: Same Stage3 pooled eta0 FP32GU slopes,32 GU intercepts, actual8laneFMA scaling, full-I pinned SiLU/A8, original canonical Down,32 actual residual output biases.
NL64.new_queries: GU for124 new experts explicitly new:18.29T integerMAC and35.722GB raw target data; Down calibration about9.15T plus fitting/FMA. No hidden reuse of transient GU from Y.

SO64_pre.transfer: Exactly the note fixed global layer-common q512/W8 B/U/host_floatlatent/identity/premerge recipe, with M_group=arithmetic mean of all64 expert M_e instead of two; same C estimator penalties per expert. One shared U per early layer, not per-leaf U or clustering.
SO64_pre.bias_and_runtime: Actual single-expert calibration; sole primary is declared F32 actual-alpha latent premerge plus weighted-slot hook, never divide by alpha. New rounding function needs separate generated/source/numeric/quality release.
SO64_pre.teacher_queries: Existing old4+new124 Y only; no new canonical targets.
SO64_pre.no_grid: No ranks/gauges/bases/merge variants selected using new16.

deferred_controls_frozen_recipes_not_exe.fairness: Equal inclusive host/cache budget, legal all-host/localbank/ordinaryload/original and shared-output/nonlinear placements. A control failure does not exclude all other families.

resources.disk_root: Current project stage4 output tree; new unique namespace, no old artifact overwrite.
resources.disk_rule: Check before phase and each expert/chunk. Retain Y/final artifacts, no full-model float duplicate or full prediction caches; preserve partials. Stop technically on cap/reserve loss.
resources.future_control_disk: Separate release. If local, cumulative96GB cap and no full GU/Down prediction caches; prove streamed exact calibration order or explicitly bill extra FMA. Otherwise separately bind NFS root>=192GB new budget/reserve; never imply Stage3 16GB covers expansion.
resources.checkpoint_rule: Preserve logs/resource samples/ownedPID cleanup. Timeout is technical/budget-inconclusive, no quality failure; no shortening rows/books or automatic model alteration.

latency_and_publication.quality_harness_walltime: Not deployment throughput; originalGGUF overwritten work/IPC present.
latency_and_publication.capacity: A one-layer bank fits host; does not prove wholemodel8e9/8GiB or flash necessity.
latency_and_publication.native_hardware: No RTL/synthesis/PE modification or simulation released by this quality protocol.
latency_and_publication.no_extrapolation: Layer-count/exposure fractions do not linearly imply NLL or wholemodel latency. Adequate nontrivial scope and matched-quality baseline evidence still required.

authorization: Draft only. Source/build/generated requires later Root+critic protocol review and separate release; each real payload phase requires its own immutable source approval. No fresh body access, target query, new fit, RTL, simulation, TEST or automaticpush.
